learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn new magic rules to change words from Singular (One) to Plural (Many) using 's', 'es', and special changing words.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 I have one balloon 🎈, but for my birthday party, I need MANY balloons 🎈🎈🎈! Let's learn the new magic spelling rules to change 'One' into 'Many'!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we talk about ONE thing, it is Singular. When we talk about MORE THAN ONE thing, it is Plural. We add special letters at the end to make them Plural.

lesson_modules.module_title: ✨ Rule 1: The Magic 's' ('s' जोड़ने का नियम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: For most naming words, we just add the letter 's' at the end to make them Many.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🪄 Rule 2: The Magic 'es' ('es' जोड़ने का नियम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: If a word ends with s, sh, ch, x, or o... we need stronger magic! We add 'es' at the end.
Some words don't listen to the 's' or 'es' rules! They change their entire spelling when they become Plural. We have to learn them like a secret code.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What is the Plural (Many) of the word 'Box'?
❓ Which is the correct Plural of 'Child'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change this word to Plural: Fox -> ____
subjective_practice.hint: Fox ends with 'x'. Which magic do we use? ('s' or 'es')

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: Look at those two ____ (man).
subjective_practice.hint: Man is a special word. It changes its spelling completely! (Men)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change this word to Plural: Potato -> ____
subjective_practice.hint: It ends with 'o'. Use the 'es' magic!

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Tooth and Teeth Smile
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draw a face with ONE big tooth and label it 'Tooth'. Then draw a face with MANY teeth and label it 'Teeth'. Smile big!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Singular means One. Plural means Many.
⭐ We add 's' to most words (Dog -> Dogs).
⭐ We add 'es' to words ending in s, sh, ch, x, o (Box -> Boxes).
⭐ Some words change spelling completely (Child -> Children).
